name: discolauncher

scripts.build-watch: npx concurrently "npm run build-watch:vite" "npm run build-watch:scss" "npm run build-watch:internal-apps" "npm run build-watch:android"
scripts.build-watch:vite: npm run clean:vite && npx concurrently "vite build --watch --mode development" "vite build --watch --mode development --config vite.worker.config.mjs"
scripts.build-watch:android: npx concurrently "npm run build:android-assets" "chokidar 'www/**/*' -c 'npm run build:android-assets'"
scripts.build-watch:web: npx concurrently "npm run build-watch:vite" "npm run build-watch:scss" "npm run build-watch:internal-apps"
scripts.build: npm run build:vite && npm run build:scss && npm run build:internal-apps && npm run build:android-assets
scripts.build:vite: npm run clean:vite && vite build --mode development && vite build --mode development --config vite.worker.config.mjs
scripts.build:production: npm run clean:vite && vite build --mode production && vite build --mode production --config vite.worker.config.mjs && npx sass --no-source-map --style=compressed src/styles.scss www/dist/styles.css && node ./scripts/build-internal-apps.mjs --production && npm run build:android-assets && echo Compilation completed.
scripts.build:debug: npm run build && echo Compilation completed.
scripts.build:android:nightly:webview: npm run build:production && cd android && ./gradlew assembleNightlyRelease -Pandroid.injected.signing.store.file=$PWD/app/keystore.jks -Pandroid.injected.signing.store.password=$KEYSTORE_PASSWORD -Pandroid.injected.signing.key.alias=discocherry -Pandroid.injected.signing.key.password=$KEY_PASSWORD -Pandroid.injected.flavor=nightly && cd ..
scripts.build:android:nightly:geckoview: npm run build:production && cd android && ./gradlew assembleNightlyGeckoViewRelease -Pandroid.injected.signing.store.file=$PWD/app/keystore.jks -Pandroid.injected.signing.store.password=$KEYSTORE_PASSWORD -Pandroid.injected.signing.key.alias=discocherry -Pandroid.injected.signing.key.password=$KEY_PASSWORD && cd ..
scripts.build:android:nightly: npm run build:android:nightly:webview && npm run build:android:nightly:geckoview
scripts.build:android:release: npm run build:production && cd android && ./gradlew :app:bundleRelease :app:assembleRelease -Pandroid.injected.signing.store.file=$PWD/app/keystore.jks -Pandroid.injected.signing.store.password=$KEYSTORE_PASSWORD -Pandroid.injected.signing.key.alias=discocherry -Pandroid.injected.signing.key.password=$KEY_PASSWORD && cd ..
scripts.debug:android: npm run build:debug && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebugFlavorDebug && cd .. && adb install android/app/build/outputs/apk/debugFlavor/debug/app-debugFlavor-arm64-v8a-debug.apk && adb shell am start -n io.github.cherryhoax.discolauncher2.debug/io.github.cherryhoax.discolauncher2.MainActivity
scripts.debug:android:geckoview: npm run build:debug && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebugFlavorGeckoViewDebug && cd .. && adb install "android/app/build/outputs/apk/debugFlavorGeckoView/debug/app-debugFlavorGeckoView-$(adb shell getprop ro.product.cpu.abi | tr -d '\r')-debug.apk" && adb shell am start -n io.github.cherryhoax.discolauncher2.debug.geckoview/io.github.cherryhoax.discolauncher2.MainActivity

author: cherryhoax
description: A groovy personalized home screen experience for Android
